tonight.headline: Nicky Jam on Thursday — and a 7.3-point lineup fix before then
body: Bad news first: Week 9 went 97.96 to 141.12 and AVIATO are 3-6. Garrett Wilson is still in the concussion protocol and Etienne has not opened his practice window.
Week 10 starts Thursday with Diggs, Likely and the Giants D/ST in Washington-New York. ESPN has AVIATO 123.95 to 101.55 as set, 62%; the projection lineup adds 7.3. Claims clear Wednesday 02:00 CDMX.

case.label: The swing
case.body: Warren for Allgeier is 6.9 of the 7.3. Boston's claim adds about 1.6 more over Metcalf.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: McCarthy ruled out Thursday would cut Likely and help the Giants D/ST's opponent; Willis ruled out would cut Gordon's offense.

doFirst.title: Claim Denzel Boston
doFirst.subtitle: Drop Alvin Kamara — Estime took his early downs and he cannot reach this lineup.

case.label: The player
case.body: Cleveland's target leader every week: 8, 11 and 7 targets in Weeks 7-9 (archive), 98 yards against New Orleans while playing through a calf strain (NBC 6 and 8 Nov). Waivers, 78.6% rostered elsewhere — Bok-aneers cut him healthy.

case.label: The quarterback
case.body: Deshaun Watson is 'expected to start vs. Texans' (Fowler via NBC 9 Nov), though Monken would not name a starter Monday (NBC 9 Nov). Boston's best week (11 targets, Week 8) came with Watson.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Kamara: 6 carries to Estime's 15 in Week 9 (archive; NBC 8 Nov), Kendre Miller released for Estime (NBC 7 Nov), Etienne due back. 64% rostered — the market still values the name; the role says otherwise. Etienne is not the drop: his owner thesis runs to Week 11 and nothing in it has tripped. Diggs and Allgeier are on the screen's exposure list.

case.label: This week
case.body: Boston projects 12.8, above Metcalf 11.2 and Diggs 10.8 — he starts at WR2 if the claim lands. Cleveland's bye is Week 11. Chem priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Boston draws under 5 targets with Watson starting in Week 10 (archive), or Kamara outscores him in Week 10 wherever he lands.

doFirst.title: Start Metcalf over Diggs
doFirst.subtitle: A coin flip (11.2 to 10.8) — take the projection. If Boston's claim lands, start Boston over both.

case.label: The call
case.body: The lineup check labels it COIN FLIP: 0.4 points. Policy is to take the projection and write no thesis. Diggs plays Thursday, so it has to be set before 19:15 CDMX Thursday.

case.label: The news either way
case.body: Burks is 'optimistic' to return Thursday (RotoBaller ~9 Nov), which trims Diggs' vacated targets; Pittman is 'nearing return' for Pittsburgh (RotoBaller 9 Nov), which would trim Metcalf's. Neither is ruled. No override.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Before Thursday 19:15 CDMX. If Boston is on the roster by then, he starts at WR2 and both sit.

doFirst.title: Start Warren at FLEX, bench Allgeier
doFirst.subtitle: 6.9 points of projection, and Warren is back from the bye.

case.label: The gap
case.body: Warren 15.6 at Cincinnati, Allgeier 8.7 against the Rams — a PROJECTION gap, not a coin flip. Warren sat in the bench row only because Pittsburgh were on bye in Week 9.

case.label: Why not Allgeier
case.body: Allgeier has all of Arizona's carries (17 of 17 in Week 9, archive) — his thesis holds — but the role is priced and ESPN still has him at 8.7. Share is not a reason to overrule the projection.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Allgeier outscores Warren in Week 10 (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: Week 9 was lost by 43 in the starting lineup, not on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: 97.96 to Talla Metralla's 141.12. Only 1.3 sat on the bench (Kamara 7.9 over Allgeier 6.6, a coin flip).

case.label: What happened
case.body: Every starter but Likely, Fairbairn and the Giants D/ST missed: Allen 12.9 (20.2 proj), Jefferson 8.8, Gordon 7.4, Allgeier 6.6, Tuten 8.9 (archive). No lineup would have won.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing about the method — one week's points never move the lineup. It is why the Warren swap matters: he is the only clear projection gain on the roster this week, and Boston is the only wire gain.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second straight week where the projection lineup loses by more than 30 would be a roster problem worth a trade look, not a lineup one.

worthALook.name: Zach Charbonnet
worthALook.lead: Seattle's lead back now Kenneth Walker is a Chief — but there is no clean seat to put him in.

case.label: The player
case.body: Led Seattle with 16 carries in Week 9 (NBC 8 Nov); 64% of the backfield (archive). Walker scored three times for Kansas City (Chiefs.com). ESPN 14.5 this week.

case.label: The problem
case.body: He would be Chem's fourth back behind Tuten, Gordon and Warren and would not start. The one clean drop (Kamara) goes to Boston. Etienne's seat is held by an open thesis until Week 11; Wilson is 97% rostered and may clear protocol.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wilson ruled out again Wednesday with no return date, or Etienne's thesis tripping — then claim Charbonnet next week if he is still there. Seattle's bye is Week 11.
